title: Im making a city builde, short clip of the gameplay and features.
author: CadenKalez
selftext:
I spent the last 15 days building a city builder alone with Claude Opus 5.5. I call it Grid Cities, and my main inspiration was SimCity 4. I always wanted a good spiritual successor to SimCity, so I decided to make one.

Everything is built from scratch with no premade engine. The assets were generated with Fable 5.2, textures are from ambientCG, and the sounds are from royalty free sources. About 90% of it was vibe coded, though if I had just given Claude a simple prompt with no direction it never would have turned out like this. For 15 days of development it holds up pretty well. The game already has 100k lines of code, with 9k lines just for the custom Metal renderer, which would take an experienced developer at least two years to make. everything the AI couldnt do alone i drew in a piece of paper, like the trafic network and connections, i drew the lines of how it should connect and asked claude opus on the max settings to improve the explanation and create research paper on how the roads bends and merges. i also create an organic and procedural lot system, where it uses math to splits the lots in a obb quare splitting and a algorithin that decides the house sizes and what features to add, with up to 200 styles devided within 16 classes like residencial, comercial and indutrial, low densty to ultra density.

In the meantime, I'm sharing this short gameplay clip showing me starting a city and then a disaster showcase with emergency vehicle responses. The disasters are the coolest part right now, but I want the core gameplay to be even more fun than the disasters. Next I'm focusing on highways, citizen life routines, bureaucracy, government, and building a deeper connection between the player and the citizens, just like Frostpunk 2.

Performance and simulation speed are also a huge focus for this game. This footage is running natively on a MacBook Air M1 with the Metal API, and I'm working on a Vulkan renderer to cover Windows and Linux too.

I'm planning to release an early build on itch. io for $15 first, and then the 1.0 version on Steam with mass transit like trains and airports, plus outside highway connections. Stay tuned, and if you guys have any questions I'll answer them in the comments.

Also i post dayli updates and full gameplay videos on my youtube channel: [https://www.youtube.com/@cadenkalez9246](https://www.youtube.com/@cadenkalez9246)
